text:
toni: Postmortem follow-up: we need clear owners + done criteria for streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partials, reconnects). I'll track progress here.

yusuf: I'll take reconnect/backoff and the SDK rate-limit. Acceptance: client+server backoff deployed to staging, SDK caps reconnects to 1/min default, max_retries configurable. PR ETA 2027-05-06.

toni: Good. Define a CI gate: PRs must not increase median TTFB by >8% on the micro-benchmark.

yusuf: Will add a lightweight PR benchmark job that fails on regression.

maya: I'll own detection + close codes for partial responses. Plan: detect truncated frames, emit metric streaming.partial_flag and close code 432. PR ETA 2027-05-11. I'll add e2e tests injecting truncated frames.

infra-bot: note: observed pattern: partials spike during autoscaler downscale. Infra will reserve a small warm worker pool for canary.

toni: Ops, schedule a 48h canary after staging merges. Need synthetic that exercises reconnect flood and model cold starts.

ops-bot: canary "chat-reliability-48h" set for 2027-05-14 01:00 UTC to 2027-05-16 01:00 UTC. Reports -> #eng-sre.

yusuf: Also adding resumable token header and reconnect_hint response header. Pseudoconfig: {max_retries:5, base_ms:200, max_ms:45000, jitter:0.5}.

maya: Observability asks: prefix-level trace id, time-to-first-token histogram, sampled payloads redacted (regex for token/password) stored 7d. Security review requested.

toni: Ownership recap: yusuf PR by 2027-05-06, maya PR by 2027-05-11, infra warm pool by 2027-05-10, canary 2027-05-14. I'll publish a short tracker doc and link PRs here.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync Fri 2027-05-07 16:00 UTC in #incidents.

yusuf: ACK, opening PR today.

maya: ACK, will start tests tomorrow.
